instruction: I need to create a photo slideshow using four images from my Desktop: pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png, and pic4.png. Please insert these four pictures into my current presentation, with each image on its own slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting 4 PNG images (pic1-pic4) into the presentation, with each image on its own slide. Starting with 1 slide, after inserting 4 images (one per slide), the total should be 5 slides. The evaluator verifies: (1) total of 5 slides, (2) slides 2-5 each contain exactly one image, (3) first slide has no images, (4) the correct images (pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png, pic4.png) were inserted using fuzzy matching to handle filename variations.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - 5 total slides, exactly 4 slides with images at indices 1-4, first slide has no images, each image slide has exactly one image, and correct images (pic1-pic4) were inserted

Correct image verification: Metric implements fuzzy matching (lines 77-92 in check_slide_count__360e07ae.py) to verify the specific required images (pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png, pic4.png) are present, handling filename variations robustly
Prevents false positives: Lines 94-107 verify that no extra/wrong images are present - prevents acceptance of pic5.png, pic6.png or other images that are available but not required
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses expected as a dict (lines 34-35), properly handling the 'rule' type where expected IS the rules dictionary returned by get_rule()
Proper state accessibility: Postconfig includes activate_window and Ctrl+S to save file, ensuring PPTX is saved before verification; getter uses get_vm_file to properly retrieve file from VM

Sound logic: Getter uses python-pptx library to detect picture shapes (MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE) and extract image filenames; metric implements comprehensive verification logic with proper edge case handling
validation.fix_description: Enhanced getter to extract detailed slide and image information (slide count, images per slide, slide indices with images). Updated metric to verify: (1) total of 5 slides, (2) exactly 4 slides with images at indices 1-4, (3) first slide (index 0) has no images, (4) each of the 4 slides has exactly one image. This prevents false positives from blank slides or images on wrong slides.
